title: 第八章 我的废土堡垒，谢绝参观-《无CP废土：基建养出全》
content:
第(1/3)页

    一、奔逃

    那些光点追上来了。

    林霜回头瞥了一眼，密密麻麻，在废墟间移动，像某种活物在呼吸。

    她大步在前，右手攥着***，左手拽着苏琳的衣袖。苏琳那条骨裂的左腿早已疼到麻木，钢管撑地的节奏彻底乱了，每踉跄一步，都像要把残腿从身上扯脱。

    “还有多远？“苏琳大口喘气，声音发颤。

    “前方两公里，有座机械加工厂——是旧地图上标注的维修点，比清泉镇近十倍。“林霜盯着前方，“钢混结构，能扛冲击。“

    “具体多远？“

    “两公里。“

    两公里，平地常人十五分钟就能到。可苏琳拖着伤腿，走在碎石瓦砾遍布的废墟间，这两公里，煎熬得如同八公里。

    身后的异响越来越近。不是人类奔跑的脚步声，是成片节肢动物附肢刮擦地面的细碎声响，密密麻麻、窸窸窣窣，像暴雨狂砸铁皮，却比雨声更阴冷、更黏腻，听得人头皮发麻。

    “系统，变异生物实时距离。“

    “先头种群距宿主约四百米。蟑螂速度：约5km/h。巨鼠：约10km/h。六分钟后追上你们。“

    六分钟。苏琳的腿，每分钟走三十米撑死。两公里，要一个多小时。变异潮六分钟就到。

    林霜脑中飞速推演利弊，当即定下决断。

    她骤然止步，把弩从背上解下来，塞给苏琳。箭袋里还有十二支，省着用。

    “拿着。上弦了，扳机轻，别碰。“

    苏琳接过弩，手臂猛地一沉，才发觉这把制式弩远比看上去沉重压手。

    “你要做什么？“她心头一紧。

    “引开它们。“林霜掏出最后半块压缩饼干，掰碎，撒在背包外面。又把壶里最后几滴水倒在裤腿上——水里有血腥味，能引开它们。

    “你疯了！“苏琳一把攥住她的胳膊，眼底满是慌张，“几千只，你会被撕碎！“

    “我死不了。“林霜轻轻掰开她的手指，语气冷静得没有一丝波澜，“你往工厂走，能走多快走多快。我引开它们，甩开就去找你。“

    “万一甩不掉呢？“

    “那就杀出一条生路。“

    话音落下，林霜瞥见合围圈东南角有一处缺口——是两条废墟巷道交汇的盲区，变异潮尚未完全封死。她调转方向，朝缺口直冲过去，边跑边撒碎屑。

    身后那些游荡的幽绿鬼火，瞬间像被磁石吸附的铁屑，齐刷刷调转方向，疯了一般朝她奔袭而去。

    苏琳伫立在原地，怀抱着沉重的***，怔怔望着林霜的身影转瞬隐入废墟暗影。密密麻麻的变异生物浪潮，从她身侧五十米外汹涌掠过，没有一只驻足侧目——所有凶戾的注意力，全被那满身食物气味的身影牢牢牵引。

    她死死咬住下唇，压下心底的酸涩与慌乱，转身拄紧钢管，一瘸一拐，艰难朝工厂方向挪动。

    二、工厂

    林霜在断壁残垣间疾驰，身后变异潮涌动的声响如浪潮追袭，始终紧贴耳畔。

    她不用回头，听声音就知道距离。越来越近。

    变异生物的全速移动速度，已然追上她的冲刺极限。她短时爆发时速勉强能持平废土巨鼠，可体能撑不了太久。三分钟后体力下滑，便是被追上的死局。

    她必须在三分钟内，找到一处能居高避险、隔绝追兵的据点。

    林霜边跑边扫视四周，系统同时播报热源距离。周边备选点位：地下停车场入口遭废墟封堵、倒塌商场结构摇摇欲坠、排水干渠狭窄易被堵死，无一稳妥。

    就在这时，一座庞然大物映入眼帘。

    前面有座高塔，混凝土的，像烟囱。

    “系统，扫描热源。“

    “塔内无热源，结构完整，高度约四十米。“

    垂直高墙，巨鼠与蟑螂根本无法攀爬。就算在塔底堆叠，也绝够不到高处平台。

    林霜立刻调转方向，全力朝冷却塔狂奔。

    塔底留有一扇半开的锈蚀检修门，破败门扇在阴风里轻轻晃荡。她冲进门内，反手用力推合，捡起地上一根粗钢管，死死别住门把手。

    塔内瞬间陷入漆黑，空气潮湿沉闷，混杂着霉腐与蝙蝠粪便的刺鼻异味。林霜拧亮那只军用手电——是昨夜从收割者营地偷的，电量还足。光柱扫过内壁，锈迹斑斑的铁制爬梯蜿蜒向上，虽布满锈蚀，承重却依旧稳妥。

    她将石斧别在腰后，匕首横咬在口中，右手扣住爬梯横杆，左手虚扶，左脚蹬梯，右腿发力，一寸一寸向上攀爬。左臂每抬一次，伤口便撕裂一分，她咬紧牙关，血顺着肘部滴在梯级上。

    爬到约莫十米高，她停在一层平台。往下看，巨鼠堆在塔底，够不着。

    检修门已被暴怒的巨鼠硬生生撞开。

    几只体型硕大的废土巨鼠堵在门口，鼻翼疯狂翕动嗅探气息，随即齐刷刷抬起头颅，幽绿的眼珠死死锁定高处的林霜。

    它们精准察觉到了猎物的位置。

    但一切如林霜所料，这群变异巨鼠前爪虽能短暂攀附，后腿却无力支撑躯体垂直登高，只能围聚在塔底焦躁吱叫，越聚越多，黑压压汇成一片。

    林霜倚着平台石壁，微微大口喘息。左臂旧伤在剧烈攀爬中再度崩裂，温热的血水浸透绷带，顺着小臂缓缓滑落，好在暂时不影响行动。

    她俯瞰塔底，目测变异潮规模。黑压压的鼠群与蟑螂潮在塔底翻涌，至少三千，还在从四面八方汇聚。

    “系统，扫描周边热源。“

    “塔底密度高，越往外越稀。热源信号持续增加，预计四至六小时后达到峰值，随后逐步消退。“

    整整四到六个小时。意味着她要蜷缩在这方寸检修平台上，熬过漫漫长夜。

    林霜关掉手电节省电量，背靠石壁闭目凝神。手边紧挨着空置的后背，弩早已留给苏琳，如今身侧只剩石斧与匕首——弩给了苏琳，她得靠自己撑到汇合。

    一旦有变异生物侥幸攀爬上梯，她便只能近身硬杀。

    眼下暂且安全，可苏琳那边，是否顺利抵达了工厂？

    三、工厂的另一边

    苏琳走走停停，用了近一小时，才看到工厂轮廓。腿已经没知觉了，靠钢管撑着。

    厂区规模远超预想，占地足有两千多平。主体是巨型钢结构厂房，旁侧矗立一栋三层砖混附属办公楼。厂房墙体由混凝土砌块浇筑，厚度不下三十厘米，窗户狭小且全都焊着防盗铁栏，防御先天占优。

    她绕着厂区缓步巡查一圈，终于找到一处隐蔽突破口——办公楼后窗玻璃碎了，她踩着窗台翻进去。

    办公楼内部狼藉一片，翻倒的文件柜散落满地废纸，桌椅被胡乱推至角落。地面积着厚厚一层灰尘，没有新鲜脚印，看得出早已废弃数月，无人涉足。

    苏琳打亮手电，照亮幽暗走廊，确认无活物潜藏后，逐层逐间清查房间。

    一楼门厅、接待室、卫生间，还有一间简陋小厨房。橱柜深处有几罐罐头，锈迹斑斑，标签模糊了。她没敢开，先放着。

    二楼错落分布着办公室、会议室与资料室，堆放着不少泛黄文件与零散杂物。苏琳在资料室找到一沓泛黄图纸，是这座工厂的原始建设资料。

    三楼是休息室、工具间，还有一间带锁的封闭房间。苏琳抡起钢管砸烂锁扣，推门而入，竟是——

    三楼是工具间，堆着扳手、螺丝刀。还有一台小机床，积了灰，但完整。

    苏琳心头猛地一跳，眼底泛起亮色。

    这些工具零件，对有钳工底子的苏琳和学过工程修筑的林霜而言，无异于雪中送炭的宝藏。有了这些，足以在废土改造器械、打造防御、修缮物资。

    可她来不及欣喜。林霜还被困在冷却塔，被几千只变异生物围困，她必须先彻底排查厂区安全，再想办法给林霜传递平安信号。

    苏琳找到办公楼侧面的消防楼梯，扶着栏杆，单腿跳着登上天台，又沿着连通梯爬至厂房屋顶边缘。

    夜色浓稠如墨，看不清变异潮的全貌，却能清晰听见四面八方涌来的爬行异响，密密麻麻萦绕耳畔，连整片废墟大地都隐隐震颤。

    视线扫过远方，她看不到林霜的身影，却清晰望见一座冷却塔的巍峨轮廓，塔顶有细碎金属反光，在朦胧月色下若隐若现。

    是林霜！

    苏琳立刻折返三楼，从办公室抽屉翻出一面破镜子，对着冷却塔方向晃。有光就行，林霜能看懂。
    第(1/3)页

    整整四到六个小时。意味着她要蜷缩在这方寸检修平台上，熬过漫漫长夜。

    林霜关掉手电节省电量，背靠石壁闭目凝神。手边紧挨着空置的后背，弩早已留给苏琳，如今身侧只剩石斧与匕首——弩给了苏琳，她得靠自己撑到汇合。

    一旦有变异生物侥幸攀爬上梯，她便只能近身硬杀。

    眼下暂且安全，可苏琳那边，是否顺利抵达了工厂？

    三、工厂的另一边

    苏琳走走停停，用了近一小时，才看到工厂轮廓。腿已经没知觉了，靠钢管撑着。

    厂区规模远超预想，占地足有两千多平。主体是巨型钢结构厂房，旁侧矗立一栋三层砖混附属办公楼。厂房墙体由混凝土砌块浇筑，厚度不下三十厘米，窗户狭小且全都焊着防盗铁栏，防御先天占优。

    她绕着厂区缓步巡查一圈，终于找到一处隐蔽突破口——办公楼后窗玻璃碎了，她踩着窗台翻进去。

    办公楼内部狼藉一片，翻倒的文件柜散落满地废纸，桌椅被胡乱推至角落。地面积着厚厚一层灰尘，没有新鲜脚印，看得出早已废弃数月，无人涉足。

    苏琳打亮手电，照亮幽暗走廊，确认无活物潜藏后，逐层逐间清查房间。

    一楼门厅、接待室、卫生间，还有一间简陋小厨房。橱柜深处有几罐罐头，锈迹斑斑，标签模糊了。她没敢开，先放着。

    二楼错落分布着办公室、会议室与资料室，堆放着不少泛黄文件与零散杂物。苏琳在资料室找到一沓泛黄图纸，是这座工厂的原始建设资料。

    三楼是休息室、工具间，还有一间带锁的封闭房间。苏琳抡起钢管砸烂锁扣，推门而入，竟是——

    三楼是工具间，堆着扳手、螺丝刀。还有一台小机床，积了灰，但完整。

    苏琳心头猛地一跳，眼底泛起亮色。

    这些工具零件，对有钳工底子的苏琳和学过工程修筑的林霜而言，无异于雪中送炭的宝藏。有了这些，足以在废土改造器械、打造防御、修缮物资。

    可她来不及欣喜。林霜还被困在冷却塔，被几千只变异生物围困，她必须先彻底排查厂区安全，再想办法给林霜传递平安信号。

    苏琳找到办公楼侧面的消防楼梯，扶着栏杆，单腿跳着登上天台，又沿着连通梯爬至厂房屋顶边缘。

    夜色浓稠如墨，看不清变异潮的全貌，却能清晰听见四面八方涌来的爬行异响，密密麻麻萦绕耳畔，连整片废墟大地都隐隐震颤。

    视线扫过远方，她看不到林霜的身影，却清晰望见一座冷却塔的巍峨轮廓，塔顶有细碎金属反光，在朦胧月色下若隐若现。

    是林霜！

    苏琳立刻折返三楼，从办公室抽屉翻出一面破镜子，对着冷却塔方向晃。有光就行，林霜能看懂。
    第(1/3)页

1. Escape

Those light spots are catching up.

Lin Shuang glanced back. They were densely packed and moving among the ruins, like some kind of living thing breathing.

She strode forward, holding a gun in her right hand and tugging on Su Lin's sleeve with her left hand.Su Lin's fractured left leg was already numb from pain, and the rhythm of the steel pipe supporting the ground was completely disrupted. Every staggering step seemed to be tearing the stump of the leg from her body.

"How far is it?" Su Lin gasped for air, her voice trembling.

"Two kilometers ahead, there is a mechanical processing plant - it is a maintenance point marked on the old map. It is ten times closer than Qingquan Town." Lin Shuang stared at the front, "The steel-concrete structure can withstand impacts."

"How far exactly?"

"Two kilometers."

It is two kilometers, and ordinary people can get there in fifteen minutes.But Su Lin dragged her injured leg and walked among the rubble-strewn ruins. The two kilometers felt like eight kilometers.

The strange noise behind him is getting closer and closer.It was not the sound of human running footsteps, but the tiny sound of arthropod appendages scraping the ground. It was densely packed and rustling, like heavy rain hitting iron sheets, but it was colder and more sticky than the sound of rain. It made people's scalp numb.

"System, real-time distance of mutated organisms."

"The leading group is about 400 meters away from the host. Cockroach speed: about 5km/h. Giant rat: about 10km/h. I will catch up with you in six minutes."

Six minutes.Su Lin's legs were exhausted from walking thirty meters per minute.Two kilometers takes more than an hour.The mutation wave will arrive in six minutes.

Lin Shuang quickly deduced the pros and cons in his mind and made an immediate decision.

She stopped suddenly, took off the crossbow from her back, and gave it to Su Lin.There are twelve more quivers in the quiver, save them.

"Hold it. It's wound, the trigger is light, don't touch it."

Su Lin took the crossbow, her arm suddenly sank, and she realized that this standard crossbow was much heavier than it looked.

"What are you going to do?" She was worried.

"Lead them away." Lin Shuang took out the last half of a compressed biscuit, broke it into pieces, and scattered it outside the backpack.Then he poured the last few drops of water from the pot onto his trouser legs - the water had the smell of blood, which could attract them.

"You're crazy!" Su Lin grabbed her arm, her eyes full of panic, "Thousands of them, you will be torn apart!"

"I can't die." Lin Shuang gently opened her fingers and said in a calm tone, "You go to the factory as fast as you can. I'll lure them away and look for you."

“What if I can’t get rid of it?”

"Then find a way out."

As he finished speaking, Lin Shuang caught a glimpse of a gap in the southeast corner of the enclosure - a blind spot where two ruined lanes intersected, and the mutant tide had not yet completely sealed it.She turned around and headed straight for the gap, scattering debris as she ran.

The wandering green will-o’-the-wisps behind her instantly turned around like iron filings attracted by a magnet, and rushed towards her like crazy.

Su Lin stood there, holding a heavy gun in her arms, staring blankly at Lin Shuang's figure disappearing into the shadow of the ruins.The dense wave of mutated creatures surged past her fifty meters away, and no one stopped to look sideways - all the ferocious attention was firmly attracted by the figure full of food smell.

She bit her lower lip, suppressing the sourness and panic in her heart, turned around, held on to the steel pipe, limped, and moved towards the factory with difficulty.

2. Factory

Lin Shuang was galloping among the broken walls, the sound of the mutated tide behind him like a chasing wave, always close to his ears.

She doesn’t need to look back, she can tell the distance by the sound.Getting closer.

The mutant creature's full movement speed has already caught up with her sprint limit.Her short-term burst speed could barely match that of the Wasteland Giant Rat, but her physical strength couldn't last long.After three minutes, his physical strength dropped, and he was caught in a dead end.

She must find a stronghold that can be high up to avoid danger and isolate the pursuers within three minutes.

Lin Shuang glanced around while running, and the system simultaneously reported the distance to the heat source.Surrounding alternative locations: The entrance to the underground parking lot is blocked by debris, the structure of the collapsed shopping mall is crumbling, and the main drainage channel is narrow and easy to be blocked. None of them are safe.

At this moment, a huge thing came into view.

There is a tall tower in front, made of concrete, like a chimney.

"System, scan the heat source."

"There is no heat source in the tower, the structure is complete, and the height is about 40 meters."

The vertical wall is impossible for giant rats and cockroaches to climb.Even if they are stacked at the bottom of the tower, they will never be able to reach the upper platform.

Lin Shuang immediately changed direction and ran towards the cooling tower with all his strength.

There is a half-open rusty inspection door at the bottom of the tower, and the dilapidated door leaf is swaying gently in the cold wind.She rushed into the door, pushed it shut with her backhand, picked up a thick steel pipe on the ground, and held on to the door handle.

The tower was instantly plunged into darkness, the air was humid and dull, mixed with the pungent smell of mold rot and bat guano.Lin Shuang turned on the military flashlight - it was stolen from the reaper camp last night and it still had enough power.The light beam swept across the inner wall, and the rusty iron ladder snaked upwards. Although it was covered with rust, it was still stable in bearing the load.

She stuck the stone ax behind her waist, held the dagger in her mouth, clasped the ladder crossbar with her right hand, held it up with her left hand, stepped on the ladder with her left foot, exerted her power on her right leg, and climbed up inch by inch.Every time she raised her left arm, the wound tore apart. She gritted her teeth and blood dripped down the elbow onto the steps.

After climbing to about ten meters high, she stopped on the first floor platform.Looking down, giant rats are piled at the bottom of the tower, out of reach.

The access door has been forced open by an angry giant rat.

Several huge giant wasteland rats blocked the door, their nostrils waving wildly to sniff the scent, and then they all raised their heads, their green eyes locked on Lin Shuang high up.

They accurately detect the location of their prey.

But everything was as Lin Shuang expected. Although the front paws of this group of mutated giant rats could briefly cling on, their hind legs were unable to support the body to climb vertically. They could only gather at the bottom of the tower and scream anxiously. The more they gathered, the more they gathered, forming a dense mass of darkness.

Lin Shuang leaned against the stone wall of the platform, breathing heavily.The old wound on his left arm cracked again during the strenuous climb. The warm blood soaked into the bandage and slowly slid down his forearm. Fortunately, it did not affect his movement for the time being.

She looked down at the bottom of the tower and visually measured the scale of the mutation tide.A black swarm of rats and cockroaches surged at the bottom of the tower, at least three thousand of them, and they were still gathering from all directions.

"System, scan surrounding heat sources."

“The density at the bottom of the tower is high and becomes thinner as it goes outward. The heat source signal continues to increase and is expected to reach a peak in four to six hours, and then gradually subside. "

A full four to six hours.It meant that she had to huddle up on this small inspection platform and spend a long night.

Lin Shuang turned off the flashlight to save power, leaned against the stone wall and closed her eyes in concentration.Next to the vacant back, the crossbow had already been left to Su Lin. Now only the stone ax and dagger were left beside her - the crossbow was given to Su Lin, and she had to hold on until the rendezvous.

Once a mutated creature is lucky enough to climb up the ladder, she can only kill it at close range.

It’s safe for now, but has Su Lin arrived at the factory successfully?

3. The other side of the factory

Su Lin walked and walked for nearly an hour before she saw the outline of the factory.My legs had no feeling and were supported by steel pipes.

The scale of the factory far exceeds expectations, covering an area of ​​more than 2,000 square meters.The main body is a giant steel structure factory building, with a three-story brick-concrete auxiliary office building standing next to it.The walls of the factory building are made of concrete blocks, with a thickness of no less than 30 centimeters. The windows are narrow and are all welded with anti-theft iron bars, giving it a natural advantage in defense.

She walked slowly around the factory area and finally found a hidden breakthrough - the rear window of the office building was broken, so she stepped on the window sill and climbed in.

The interior of the office building was in a mess, with overturned filing cabinets scattered on the floor and waste paper, and tables and chairs randomly pushed to corners.The ground was covered with a thick layer of dust and there were no fresh footprints. It could be seen that it had been abandoned for months and no one had set foot there.

Su Lin turned on the flashlight and illuminated the dark corridor. After confirming that there was no living thing hiding, she checked the rooms floor by floor.

The first floor consists of a foyer, reception room, bathroom, and a simple kitchen.There were several cans deep in the cupboard, stained with rust and their labels blurred.She didn't dare to open it, so she let it go.

The second floor is dotted with offices, conference rooms and data rooms, and there are many yellowing documents and scattered items stacked up.Su Lin found a stack of yellowed drawings in the data room, which were the original construction materials of the factory.

The third floor is the lounge, tool room, and a locked closed room.Su Lin picked up the steel pipe and smashed the lock, pushed the door open, and saw——

The third floor is the tool room, filled with wrenches and screwdrivers.There was also a small machine tool, gathering dust but intact.

Su Lin’s heart skipped a beat, and her eyes lit up.

These tool parts are like a treasure trove for Su Lin, who has a background as a fitter, and Lin Shuang, who has studied engineering.With these, it is enough to transform equipment, build defenses, and repair materials in the wasteland.

But she had no time to rejoice.Lin Shuang is still trapped in the cooling tower, surrounded by thousands of mutated creatures. She must first thoroughly check the safety of the factory before finding a way to send a safe signal to Lin Shuang.

Su Lin found the fire stairs on the side of the office building, held on to the railing, jumped on one leg to the rooftop, and then climbed along the connecting ladder to the edge of the factory roof.

The night was as thick as ink, and it was difficult to see the full picture of the mutated tide, but one could clearly hear the crawling noises coming from all directions, lingering densely around the ears, and even the entire ruined land was faintly shaking.

She glanced across the distance. She couldn't see Lin Shuang's figure, but she could clearly see the majestic outline of a cooling tower. The top of the tower had fine metal reflections, looming under the hazy moonlight.

It’s Lin Shuang!

Su Lin immediately returned to the third floor, took out a broken mirror from the office drawer, and shook it in the direction of the cooling tower.As long as there is light, Lin Shuang can understand.
